headline: GPT-6 Astra gains independent coding capability without external dependencies
body: OpenAI's latest model iteration, GPT-6 Astra, can now execute coding tasks autonomously without relying on Codex or external code execution tools. This advancement signals a shift toward more self-contained AI systems that consolidate multiple capabilities into single models. For healthcare AI applications, this matters because clinical decision support systems and EHR integrations could reduce dependency chains and complexity in their technical architecture. The ability to generate and execute code internally improves deployment flexibility for healthcare vendors building AI-assisted workflows, though clinical validation requirements remain the primary constraint for any production implementation.
